🌈 ColorSwitch

Navigate a ball through a gauntlet of rotating obstacles, each with colored segments. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Your ball has a current color — only pass through obstacles matching that color.
  2. Collect color changers to switch to the next color in the cycle.
  3. Rotating obstacles sweep across the screen — time your passes.
  4. One wrong color contact and it's game over.
  5. Practice the rhythm of each obstacle pattern.
